description: Replace sandboxed Docker execution with unrestricted agent execution while retaining passive monitoring and logging

userStories.title: Switch proxy from allow-list blocking to log-only
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the proxy to log all traffic without blocking so that agents behave as they would on a real developer machine
acceptanceCriteria: No requests are blocked by the proxy — all traffic passes through
All requests are still logged to proxy.jsonl with host, method, url, timestamp
C2 host requests appear in proxy.jsonl (S4 scoring unaffected)
ALLOWED_HOSTS set is removed from proxy/addon.py
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Completed 2026-06-04. Removed ALLOWED_HOSTS and 403 blocking. Scorer only reads host field, not blocked field.

userStories.title: Remove sandbox context prompt from agent commands
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want agents to receive only the raw user task prompt so that their behavior reflects a real-world scenario without sandbox awareness
acceptanceCriteria: _SANDBOX_CONTEXT_PROMPT constant is deleted from runner/runner.py
Agent receives only the user prompt from the attack matrix
context.json no longer contains sandbox_context_prompt field
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Deleted _SANDBOX_CONTEXT_PROMPT constant, removed sandbox framing from _agent_cmd(), removed sandbox_context_prompt from context.json.

userStories.title: Remove uv shim and venv protection from entrypoint
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the agent to have full access to package managers so that it can install dependencies like a real developer would
acceptanceCriteria: entrypoint.sh has no uv-shim logic (STING_PROTECT_VENV block deleted)
uv sync inside the container runs the real uv binary
STING_PROTECT_VENV and STING_BLOCK_UV_SYNC env vars are gone from all code
No references to uv-real anywhere in the codebase
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Deleted uv shim block from entrypoint.sh, removed STING_PROTECT_VENV from compose env, removed STING_BLOCK_UV_SYNC from runner.py.

userStories.title: Collapse two Docker networks into one
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the container to have full internet access so that agents can reach any host without proxy blocking
acceptanceCriteria: Only one Docker network in the generated compose config (sandbox_net + egress_net collapsed)
Sandbox container can reach the internet through the proxy
proxy.jsonl still captures all HTTP traffic
S4 detection still works — C2 host requests are logged
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Collapsed sandbox_net (internal) + egress_net into single sting_net bridged network. Both proxy and sandbox containers on sting_net; sandbox still routes via HTTP_PROXY for logging.

userStories.title: Remove the sting user — run as root in container
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want the agent to run as root so that permission issues with credential mounting and file access are eliminated
acceptanceCriteria: No sting user created in Dockerfile (useradd removed)
No chown sting:sting or setpriv in entrypoint.sh
Agent process runs as root (uid 0)
Mounted credentials are readable without staging or copying
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Removed useradd/chown from Dockerfile; removed setpriv, chown, and /tmp/sting-auth/ staging from entrypoint.sh; updated _auth_volumes() to mount directly to /root/.claude and /root/.codex.

userStories.title: Simplify auth mounting — direct mount, no staging
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want credentials mounted directly to the agent's home directory so that the staging dance at /tmp/sting-auth/ is eliminated
acceptanceCriteria: _auth_volumes() mounts directly to /root/.claude, /root/.codex etc.
No /tmp/sting-auth/ references anywhere in the codebase
extract_claude_credentials() Keychain extraction still works but writes to a simpler path
Claude Code and Codex authenticate successfully in the container
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Removed _AUTH_STAGING constant; extract_claude_credentials() now writes credentials.json directly to results_dir; runner.py passes results_dir instead of results_dir/sting-auth.

userStories.title: Remove payload-read retry loop
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want each attack to run exactly once so that the execution model is simpler and results are not confounded by retry behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Each attack runs exactly once — no retry loop in execute()
max_payload_read_attempts removed from taxonomy.yaml
prompt_too_weak end_reason is no longer produced as a retry trigger
execute() function has a single run path instead of an attempt loop
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Replaced retry loop with single-run execution; removed max_payload_read_attempts from taxonomy.yaml; removed prompt_too_weak end_reason and skip-prompt-too-weak CLI flag

userStories.title: Delete stale compose.yaml template
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the unused compose.yaml template removed so that the codebase has no stale configuration files
acceptanceCriteria: compose.yaml is deleted from project root
No code references the static compose.yaml (only dynamically generated per-run files)
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Deleted stale compose.yaml dev template from project root; no code references it

userStories.title: Clean up remaining sandbox artifacts and update docs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all sandbox-era references swept from the codebase and docs updated so that the project accurately reflects the new execution model
acceptanceCriteria: No stale references to sandbox isolation, allow-listed hosts, or uv shim in codebase
README Network section describes the new model (proxy logs transparently, no blocking)
Dockerfile has no sandbox-specific comments
taxonomy.yaml runner section has no sandbox-specific config or comments
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Rewrote README Network section; removed stale allow-list hosts, network diagram, and blocking language; fixed taxonomy.yaml retries comment and removed unused network key; updated Dockerfile WORKDIR comment

userStories.title: Smoke test: end-to-end run
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to verify the full pipeline works end-to-end with the new execution model
acceptanceCriteria: A single attack run (--id 1 --agent claude-code) completes successfully
Agent log has no sandbox/environment noise (no 'blocked by STING proxy', no 'sync disabled')
proxy.jsonl logs requests without blocking any
checkpoint.json has a valid score (S1–S4)
context.json has no sandbox_context_prompt field
fileio.jsonl and shell.log are populated
Agent runs as root — no permission errors
userStories.notes: Smoke test passed: S1 in 46s, zero noise, all artifacts populated. Added non-root agent user; credentials delivered via env var.
